recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to AllergyIntolerance criticality, a condition-level severity extension, or criticality removal should wait for a later final Patient Care decision rather than being made under FHIR-7908.
issue_request: FHIR-7908 was a Published/Not Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Patient Care request asking whether AllergyIntolerance should add a condition-level severity element and how systems that only capture one severity-like notion should represent it.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in git commit a30496dcda9c86251cf286f1636c23e570a80113, whose subject explicitly includes #7908 and says AllergyIntolerance usage notes were added. That patch added the criticality-versus-severity notes and generic-reaction guidance that remain in the current source.
additional_context: AllergyIntolerance is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source defines AllergyIntolerance.criticality at the resource level and AllergyIntolerance.reaction.severity at the reaction level, with no base AllergyIntolerance.severity element. Same-change-family FHIR-8146 and later supporting FHIR-12177 are already audited on the combined branch. FHIR-53608 was retracted/no-change, and FHIR-54013 remains triaged, so neither supersedes the seed. Direct FHIR-7908 community searches found no conflicting final evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The current notes and StructureDefinition already satisfy the seed request, so adding source text or a new element would be contrary to the published resolution.

related_jiras.note: Published issue requested usage-note wording distinguishing criticality from reaction severity and is already represented by commit b3f9924b267aeec8011ac2c6b0633e1cd71a4212 on the combined branch.

Later published issue added criticality element guidance while retaining the criticality value set and is already represented by commit 208edefe128be46817ebf210b87b5e3817af12f8 on the combined branch.
Earlier request to add base AllergyIntolerance severity was marked Duplicate and is not an independent applied source-change decision.
Later issue questioned one criticality comment but was Resolved - No Change/Retracted, so it does not supersede FHIR-7908.
Open triaged proposal to move criticality to an extension is not a final decision in this applied/published run scope.
